name: Camp Aparaje
summary: Grimtotem warriors hold Camp Aparaje in the eastern heights of the Stonetalon Mountains. The tribe slaughtered the peaceful tauren who settled there and claimed the outpost.

sections.title: A Tragic Downfall
sections.body: Camp Aparaje lies among the Stonetalon crags, where peaceful tauren once sought a quiet life in the highlands. Raiders from nearby Grimtotem Post struck under Grundig Darkcloud's lead. The attackers butchered villagers or drove them away. Survivors such as Makaba Flathoof mourn the loss of their home and fear for kin taken captive.

sections.title: Under Grimtotem Sway
sections.body: Grimtotem warriors now occupy Camp Aparaje as a forward base for their aggressive tribe in the region. Many Grimtotem settlements bear blue markings, but the great totem here is carved with deep crimson paint.

faq.q: Who used to live at Camp Aparaje?
faq.answer: Peaceful tauren affiliated with the Horde and Bloodhoof tribe lived at Camp Aparaje, including Makaba Flathoof and his daughter Kaya, before the settlement was invaded.

faq.q: Why is the camp hostile to Horde players?
faq.answer: The Grimtotem seized the village by force. The xenophobic, treacherous tauren clan rejects Cairne Bloodhoof's authority and attacks outsiders, including members of the Horde.

faq.q: Who led the assault on Camp Aparaje?
faq.answer: Grundig Darkcloud led the assault from Grimtotem Post. The brutal Grimtotem chieftain seeks to extend his tribe's violent hold over Stonetalon.

faq.q: What happened to the surviving villagers?
faq.answer: Most villagers died in the raid. A few escaped, while others, including young Kaya Flathoof, were captured and held at nearby Grimtotem Post.

angles.text: As a tauren, you can see Camp Aparaje's ruins as a reminder of the cruelty of Magatha's Grimtotem tribe. Not all children of the Earth Mother share Cairne Bloodhoof's vision of honor and peace.
As a member of the Horde, you have reason to drive the Grimtotem from Camp Aparaje in vengeance and defense. The tribe butchered innocent Horde subjects in Stonetalon.
